cells.content: 閏二月庚寅，司馬光自正議大夫、守門下侍郎依前官加左僕射兼門下侍郎。壬辰，呂公著自金紫光祿大夫、尚書左丞加門下侍郎。四月壬寅，呂公著自金紫光祿大夫、門下侍郎依前官加右僕射兼中書侍郎。文彥博自河東節度使、守太師、開府儀同三司、潞國公落致仕加太師、平章軍國重事。 韓縝 蔡確 司馬光 呂公著 文彥博

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day gengyin: Sima Guang, from Right Policy Grand Master and Acting Vice Director of the Chancellery, was promoted while retaining his former rank to Left Grand Chancellor concurrently serving as Vice Director of the Chancellery. Day renchen: Lü Gongzhu, from Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery. Fourth month, day renyin: Lü Gongzhu, from Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and Vice Director of the Chancellery, was promoted while retaining his former rank to Right Grand Chancellor concurrently serving as Vice Director of the Secretariat. Wen Yanbo, from Military Governor of Hedong, Acting Grand Preceptor, Grand Preceptor of the Palace with Honors Equal to the Three Divisions, and Duke of Lu, was removed from retirement and promoted to Grand Preceptor and Administrator of State Affairs. Han Zhen, Cai Que, Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Wen Yanbo.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary second month, gengyin: Sima Guang rose from Acting Vice Director of the Chancellery to Left Grand Chancellor, retaining that vice directorship. On renchen, Lü Gongzhu moved from Left Assistant Director to Vice Director of the Chancellery. In the fourth month, renyin, Lü Gongzhu became Right Grand Chancellor and Vice Director of the Secretariat; Wen Yanbo left retirement as Duke of Lu and Military Governor of Hedong to serve again as Grand Preceptor and Administrator of State Affairs. The grand chancellors were Han Zhen, Cai Que, Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, and Wen Yanbo.

cells.content: 閏二月庚寅，左僕射蔡確累為劉摯、孫覺、蘇轍、朱光庭、王巖叟所論，守前官以觀文殿大學士知陳州。四月己丑，韓縝自右僕射以光祿大夫、觀文殿大學士知潁昌府、京西北路安撫使。九月丙辰朔，左僕射兼門下侍郎司馬光薨。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day gengyin: Left Grand Chancellor Cai Que was repeatedly impeached by Liu Zhi, Sun Jue, Su Zhe, Zhu Guangting, and Wang Yansou; he retained his former rank and was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and prefect of Chenzhou. Fourth month, day jichou: Han Zhen, from Right Grand Chancellor, was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture, prefect of Yingchang Prefecture, and Pacification Commissioner of the Jingxi-North Circuit. Ninth month, day bingchen new moon: Left Grand Chancellor and Vice Director of the Chancellery Sima Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary second month, gengyin: Left Grand Chancellor Cai Que, assailed by Liu Zhi, Sun Jue, Su Zhe, Zhu Guangting, and Wang Yansou, kept his rank but was sent out as Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture at Chenzhou. In the fourth month, jichou, Han Zhen left the Right Grand Chancellorship for Yingchang as Grand Academician and Pacification Commissioner of the Jingxi-North Circuit. Sima Guang, Left Grand Chancellor and Vice Director of the Chancellery, died on the bingchen new moon of the ninth month.

cells.content: 閏二月丙午，李清臣自通議大夫、守尚書右丞除尚書左丞。 呂大防自試吏部尚書除中大夫、尚書右丞。乙卯，安燾自同知樞密院事進知樞密院事。范純仁自試吏部尚書兼侍讀除中大夫、同知樞密院事。五月丁巳朔，韓維自資政殿大學士、正議大夫兼侍讀除守門下侍郎。十一月戊午，劉摯自試御史中丞除中大夫、尚書右丞。呂大防自中大夫、尚書左丞除中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day bingwu: Li Qingchen, from Policy Grand Master and Acting Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs. Lü Dafang, from Acting Minister of Personnel, was appointed Palace Attendant and Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs. Day yimao: An Tao, from Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Fan Chunren, from Acting Minister of Personnel and concurrent Reader-in-Attendance, was appointed Palace Attendant and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Fifth month, day dingsi new moon: Han Wei, from Grand Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance, Right Policy Grand Master, and concurrent Reader-in-Attendance, was appointed Acting Vice Director of the Chancellery. Eleventh month, day wuwu: Liu Zhi, from Acting Vice Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Palace Attendant and Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs. Lü Dafang, from Palace Attendant and Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary second month, bingwu: Li Qingchen became Left Assistant Director; Lü Dafang became Right Assistant Director. On yimao, An Tao advanced from Vice Commissioner to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Fan Chunren joined the council as Vice Commissioner. In the fifth month, dingsi new moon, Han Wei was named Acting Vice Director of the Chancellery. That autumn, wuwu, Liu Zhi became Right Assistant Director and Lü Dafang Vice Director of the Secretariat.

Ninth month, day jimao: Zhang Bian, from Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and prefect of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary second month, xinhai: Zhang Dun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was driven out after impeachment by Liu Zhi, Wang Yansou, and Zhu Guangting and an unruly quarrel at court; he kept his rank as prefect of Ruzhou. In the ninth month, jimao, Zhang Bian left the Secretariat vice directorship for Zhengzhou as Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance.

cells.content: 四月丁巳，李邦彥丁憂起復。八月乙卯，童貫自劍南東川節度使落致仕，依前太師、領樞密院事、陝西河北河東燕山府路宣撫使，進封徐、豫國公。九月乙亥，趙野自中大夫、尚書右丞遷尚書左丞。宇文粹中自翰林學士承旨、宣奉大夫除尚書右丞。蔡懋自朝議大夫、試開封府尹除中大夫、同知樞密院事。蔡攸自少師安遠軍節度使領樞密院事落節鉞，依前少師。

Cai You, from Junior Preceptor and military commissioner of Anyuan Army, was relieved of his command while retaining charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs and his Junior Preceptor title.

translations.literal: First month, day xinwei: Li Bangyan, from Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, Junior Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat, was recalled from mourning and given the special advancement rank as Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery. Zhang Bangchang, from Grand Master for Court Audience, was specially appointed to remain Junior Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat and Commissioner of the Divine Empyrean Jade Clarity Palace of Longevity. Second month, day gengxu: he was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery. Wu Min, from Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was transferred to Grand Palace Attendant as Junior Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat. Third month, day jisi: Xu Churen, from Acting Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Grand Master for Court Audience as Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery. Eighth month, day jiwei: Tang Que, from Grand Master for Court Audience, was made Junior Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat. Intercalary eleventh month, day renchen: He Meng, from Acting Vice Director of the Chancellery, was made Grand Master for Court Audience, Right Grand Chancellor, and Vice Director of the Secretariat. The grand ministers were Cai Jing, Bai Shizhong, Li Bangyan, Zhang Bangchang, Wu Min, Xu Churen, Tang Que, and He Meng.

cells.content: 正月辛未，白時中自太宰以觀文殿大學士領中太乙宮使依前特進、慶國公。二月庚戌，李邦彥自太宰兼門下侍郎以觀文殿學士領中太乙宮使。甲寅蔡京自太師、魯國公致仕責授中奉大夫、祕書監、分司南京，河南居住。三月己巳，張邦昌自太宰、兼門下侍郎以觀文殿大學士領中太乙宮使。八月己未，徐處仁自太宰以觀文殿大學士領中太乙宮使。吳敏自少宰以觀文殿大學士領醴泉觀使。閏十一月壬辰朔，唐恪自少宰以觀文殿大學士領中太乙宮使兼侍讀依前光祿大夫。

translations.literal: First month, day xinwei: Bai Shizhong, from Grand Minister, was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace, retaining his special advancement rank and title as Duke of Qing. Second month, day gengxu: Li Bangyan, from Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, was made Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace. Day jiayin: Cai Jing, from retired Grand Preceptor and Duke of Lu, was demoted to Grand Master for Court Audience, Director of the Palace Library, and nominal officeholder in Nanjing, with residence in Henan. Third month, day jisi: Zhang Bangchang, from Grand Minister and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace. Eighth month, day jiwei: Xu Churen, from Grand Minister, was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace. Wu Min, from Junior Grand Minister, was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey. Intercalary eleventh month, day renchen new moon: Tang Que, from Junior Grand Minister, was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace with concurrent Reader-in-Attendance, retaining his former rank as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on xinwei, Bai Shizhong left the Grand Ministry for the Hall for Cultivating Culture and the Central Grand Empyrean palace, keeping his special rank as Duke of Qing. In the second month, on gengxu, Li Bangyan took the same path; on jiayin Cai Jing was demoted from retirement to Palace Library director in Nanjing and sent to live in Henan. Zhang Bangchang, Xu Churen, Wu Min, and Tang Que were successively shifted from the Grand and Junior Grand Ministries to palace and abbey commissions through the intercalary eleventh month.

cells.content: 正月己巳，吳敏自中大夫、守門下侍郎除知樞密院事、親征行營副使。李梲自正奉大夫、守吏部尚書除同知樞密院事。庚午，李綱自試兵部侍郎、中大夫除尚書右丞。辛未，趙野自通議大夫，尚書左丞除門下侍郎。王孝迪自通議大夫、翰林學士承旨除中書侍郎。蔡懋自中大夫、同知樞密院事除尚書左丞。甲戌，唐恪自正議大夫、守吏部尚書除同知樞密院事。耿南仲自簽書樞密院事進同知樞密院事。辛巳，路允迪自試兵部尚書除資政殿學士、簽書樞密院事。丁亥，種師道自檢校少保、靜難軍節度使、河北河東制置使除同知樞密院事。二月戊戌，尚書右丞李綱罷，辛丑復職。癸卯，徐處仁自觀文殿大學士、大名尹除中書侍郎。宇文虛中自保和殿大學士除資政殿大學士、簽書樞密院事。庚戌，李綱自中大夫、尚書右丞除知樞密院事。耿南仲自同知樞密院事除尚書左丞。李梲自正奉大夫、同知樞密院事除尚書右丞。三月己巳，唐恪自正議大夫、同知樞密院事依前官加中書侍郎。{上鹵下木}自翰林學士、知制誥除中大夫、尚書右丞。許翰自御史中丞除中大夫、同知樞密院事。四月癸卯，耿南仲自太中大夫、尚書左丞依前官加門下侍郎。是月，種師道自檢校少傅、中太乙宮使復除同知樞密院事。六月戊戌，李綱宣撫河北、河東。八月丙申，種師道代李綱為宣撫。己未，{上鹵下木}自太中大夫、尚書右丞除中書侍郎。陳過庭自太中大夫、試禮部尚書兼侍讀除尚書右丞。聶昌自開封府尹除中大夫、同知樞密院事。李回自朝請大夫、御史中丞兼侍讀除延康殿學士、簽書樞密院事。九月丁丑，王{上宀下禹}自禮部尚書除尚書左丞。十月丁未，馮澥自禮部尚書、太子詹事兼侍讀除中大夫、知樞密院事。十一月丁丑，陳過庭自太中大夫、尚書右丞除中書侍郎。孫傅自試兵部尚書除中大夫、尚書右丞。甲申，除同知樞密院事。曹輔自御史中丞除延康殿學士、簽書樞密院事。庚寅，{上鹵下木}自資政殿學士、中大夫、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀、領開封府事除門下侍郎。閏十一月丁酉，馮澥自資政殿學士、中大夫、太子賓客除尚書左丞。庚子，張叔夜自延康殿學士、南道都總管除簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: First month, day jisi: Wu Min, from Palace Attendant and Acting Vice Director of the Chancellery, was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Deputy Commander of the Imperial Campaign Headquarters. Li Zhuo, from Grand Master for Court Audience and Acting Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Day gengwu: Li Gang, from Acting Vice Minister of War and Palace Attendant, was appointed Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs. Day xinwei: Zhao Ye, from Policy Grand Master and Left Assistant Director, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery. Wang Xiaodi, from Policy Grand Master and Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat. Cai Mao, from Palace Attendant and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed Left Assistant Director. Day jiaxu: Tang Que, from Right Policy Grand Master and Acting Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Geng Nanzhong, from Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted to Vice Commissioner. Day xinsi: Lu Yundi, from Acting Vice Minister of War, was appointed Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance and Deputy Commissioner. Day dinghai: Zhong Shidao, from Acting Junior Guardian, military commissioner of Jingnan Army, and Commissioner for Hebei and Hedong, was appointed Vice Commissioner. Second month, day wuxu: Right Assistant Director Li Gang was dismissed; on day xinchou he was restored. Day guimao: Xu Churen, from Grand Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and prefect of Daming, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat. Yu Wen Xuzhong, from Grand Academician of the Hall of Preserving Harmony, was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance and Deputy Commissioner. Day gengxu: Li Gang, from Palace Attendant and Right Assistant Director, was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Geng Nanzhong, from Vice Commissioner, was appointed Left Assistant Director. Li Zhuo, from Grand Master for Court Audience and Vice Commissioner, was appointed Right Assistant Director. Third month, day jisi: Tang Que, from Right Policy Grand Master and Vice Commissioner, was made concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat while retaining his former office. He Meng, from Hanlin Academician and drafter of edicts, was appointed Palace Attendant and Right Assistant Director. Xu Han, from Vice Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Palace Attendant and Vice Commissioner. Fourth month, day guimao: Geng Nanzhong, from Grand Palace Attendant and Left Assistant Director, was made concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery while retaining his former office. That month, Zhong Shidao, from Acting Junior Mentor and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace, was again appointed Vice Commissioner. Sixth month, day wuxu: Li Gang was made Pacification Commissioner of Hebei and Hedong. Eighth month, day bingshen: Zhong Shidao replaced Li Gang as Pacification Commissioner. Day jiwei: He Meng, from Grand Palace Attendant and Right Assistant Director, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat. Chen Guoting, from Grand Palace Attendant and Acting Minister of Rites with concurrent Reader-in-Attendance, was appointed Right Assistant Director. Nie Chang, from prefect of Kaifeng, was appointed Palace Attendant and Vice Commissioner. cells.content: 二月癸卯，蔡懋自尚書左丞以資攻殿學士、依前中大夫知大名府兼北京留守。王孝迪自中書侍郎以資政殿學士提舉醴泉觀。癸丑，種師道自同知樞密院事以檢校少傅領中太乙宮使。甲寅，童貫自太師、廣陽郡王、徐豫國公責授左衞上將軍致仕，池州居住。蔡攸自太保、領樞密院事、燕國公責授太中大夫、提舉亳州明道宮，任便居住。三月戊辰，李梲自尚書左丞以正奉大夫、資政殿學士提舉南京鴻慶宮。庚午，宇文虛中自簽書樞密院事以資政殿學士、仍中大夫出知青州。四月庚戌，趙野自門下侍郎以資政殿學士出知襄陽府。六月癸卯，路允迪自簽書樞密院事以資政殿學士提舉醴泉觀。八月戊午，許翰自同知樞密院事以延康殿學士出知亳州。九月丁丑，李綱自知樞密院事以觀文殿學士出知揚州。十月戊午，王{上宀下禹}自尚書左丞坐辭使軍前責授單州團練副使，新州安置。辛酉，種師道卒。十一月戊辰，馮澥自知樞密院除資政殿學士、太子賓客。丁丑，{上鹵下木}自中書侍郎依前官提舉醴泉觀兼侍讀。丁亥，李回自簽書樞密院事除提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao: Cai Mao, from Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance, the source title being corrupt, retaining his former rank as Palace Attendant and made prefect of Daming with concurrent charge as Northern Capital Regent. Wang Xiaodi, from Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance and Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey. Day guichou: Zhong Shidao, from Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Acting Junior Mentor and Commissioner of the Central Grand Empyrean Palace. Day jiayin: Tong Guan, from Grand Preceptor, Prince of Guangyang, and Duke of Xu and Yu, was demoted to retired General of the Left Guards and ordered to reside in Chizhou. Cai You, from Grand Guardian with charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Duke of Yan, was demoted to Grand Palace Attendant and Commissioner of the Mingdao Abbey in Bozhou, free to reside where he chose. Third month, day wuchen: Li Zhuo, from Left Assistant Director, was made Grand Master for Court Audience and Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance with charge of the Hongqing Palace in Nanjing. Day gengwu: Yu Wen Xuzhong, from Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance, retaining his Palace Attendant rank, and sent out as prefect of Qingzhou. Fourth month, day gengxu: Zhao Ye, from Vice Director of the Chancellery, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance and sent out as prefect of Xiangyang. Sixth month, day guimao: Lu Yundi, from Deputy Commissioner, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance and Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey. Eighth month, day wuwu: Xu Han, from Vice Commissioner, was made Academician of the Hall of Extended Glory and sent out as prefect of Bozhou. Ninth month, day dingchou: Li Gang, from Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and sent out as prefect of Yangzhou. Tenth month, day wuwu: Wang Yining, from Left Assistant Director, was demoted for declining an embassy before the enemy army to military vice commissioner of Danzhou, with residence ordered at Xinzhou. Day xinyou: Zhong Shidao died. Eleventh month, day wuchen: Feng Kai, from Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Academician of the Hall of Exalted Governance and Household Tutor of the Heir Apparent. Day dingchou: He Meng, from Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey with concurrent Reader-in-Attendance while retaining his former office. Day dinghai: Li Hui, from Deputy Commissioner, was made Commissioner of the Longevity Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao, Cai Mao and Wang Xiaodi left the central posts for regional and abbey assignments; Zhong Shidao took the Central Grand Empyrean palace, while Tong Guan and Cai You were harshly demoted and sent into retirement. Through the autumn, Li Zhuo, Yu Wen Xuzhong, Zhao Ye, Lu Yundi, Xu Han, and Li Gang were pushed out to the provinces; Wang Yining was punished for refusing duty at the front and sent to Xinzhou; Zhong Shidao died; and by winter Feng Kai, He Meng, and Li Hui were shifted to palace commissions.
